## WashSaleReplacementScope

Qualified name: <code>Meridian.Ledger.WashSaleReplacementScope</code>. Kind: `enum`.

Source: [src/Meridian.Ledger/WashSale.cs:9](../../../../src/Meridian.Ledger/WashSale.cs#L9).

Which accounts are searched for replacement acquisitions when matching a wash sale. The scope is a policy decision rather than a fixed rule because it materially changes the disallowed amount: a repurchase booked into a sibling custody account is a wash sale under IRC §1091 but is invisible to an account-local search.

```csharp
public enum WashSaleReplacementScope
```

Enum declarations:

| Declaration | Source | Summary |
| --- | --- | --- |
| <code>DisposingAccount</code> | [src/Meridian.Ledger/WashSale.cs:15](../../../../src/Meridian.Ledger/WashSale.cs#L15) | Only the account the loss-generating disposal relieved lots from. Narrowest scope; a repurchase booked into a sibling account under the same book does not defer the loss. |
| <code>LedgerBook</code> | [src/Meridian.Ledger/WashSale.cs:22](../../../../src/Meridian.Ledger/WashSale.cs#L22) | Every account in the disposing ledger book. A ledger book is the accounting boundary for one taxable entity, so this is the closest available analogue to the §1091 rule that looks across all of a taxpayer&#x27;s accounts rather than a single custodian. This is the default. |

## YearEndCloseInput

Qualified name: <code>Meridian.Ledger.YearEndCloseInput</code>. Kind: `record`.

Source: [src/Meridian.Ledger/YearEndClose.cs:9](../../../../src/Meridian.Ledger/YearEndClose.cs#L9).

Input for a fiscal-year-end close. Unlike a single-period close, a year-end close gates on all of its constituent periods being closed first (RequiredPeriodIds vs ClosedPeriodIds) and rolls the year&#x27;s net income forward into next year&#x27;s opening retained earnings.

## YearEndCloseProjector
